thumbnails.scene: The Geek lies in bed under a white duvet in morning light, head lifted, staring with a flat puzzled deadpan expression at the silver tabby cat sitting on his chest, its eyes half closed in bliss, faint curved vibration lines drawn around its throat.

The silver tabby cat sits tensely on a stainless-steel vet exam table, ears slightly back, eyes wide, faint vibration lines around its throat, while the Geek stands beside the table looking at it with a worried deadpan face.

In a dim dawn bedroom the silver tabby cat stands on the pillow with its face pressed right against the Geek's sleeping face, big vibration lines around its throat, while he lies with his eyes squeezed shut and a pained deadpan expression.

The Geek holds a large magnifying glass up to the throat of the silver tabby cat as it sits on a brown sofa purring with its eyes closed, his face close and studying it with a serious deadpan look, soft wave lines coming from the cat's throat.

The Geek stands in tall golden grass at dusk holding the purring silver tabby cat in his arms, looking sideways with a flat deadpan expression at a large male lion with a thick golden-brown mane that roars beside him.
